title: 130 ## IX RECIDIVISM Statistics on recidivism were available in respect of 12,89,251 offenders out of which 11,96,113 i.e., 92-78 percent were now offenders. These figures are excluding Andaman and Nicobar Islands. The percentage of persons who were convicted once, twice and three and more than three times were 5-39 percent, 1-15 percent and 0-68 percent respectively. 9-48 percent of the persons arrested, under Burglary were convicted in the past and this has accounted for the highest percentage of recidivism closely followed by the percentage of persons arrested under thefts (8-48 percent. Relevant statistics in respect of number of offenders and their percentage distribution of Recidivism are presented in tables 53 and 54.
